name: manual_f8e800
claim: When a pending subagent artifact arrives, rebuild the interim manifest and report before delivery so the bundle does not label completed work as pending.

decisions.notes: The Lane 2a ledger arrived after the first manifest was built, so the report and manifest required refresh before the LAN drop.

rationale: The Lane 2a ledger arrived after the first manifest was built, so the report and manifest required refresh before the LAN drop.
